name: inspira-spinning-text
title: Spinning Text
blurb: Text rotates continuously around its center axis.
description: Text element spins on a loop with configurable speed. Non-interactive, purely decorative.
use_when: Loading states, featured badges, or eye-catching accent elements.
avoid_when: Body content or dense layouts — spinning is disorienting and harms reading.
a11y: Text is readable at points in the rotation but not consistently. No pause or motion control.
